zh.headline: OpenAI 拟以 1.25 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元，为 IPO 铺路
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是 Agent 基础设施正在集中补齐：Google 提供硬件隔离的 Agent 运行时，1Password 解决凭据代持，Vercel 解决崩溃续跑，Anthropic 把 Skills 标准交给基金会。与此同时，银行封堵 Agent 登录、Symantec 发现自维持攻击 Agent，说明能力扩张与治理约束正在同步加速。模型侧，Recursive 的 Flint 用 2.5B 激活参数在本地跑出 74.2% SWE-bench，配合 JOLT 的 6.5 倍 token 节省，小团队自建编码 Agent 的门槛正快速下降。值得警惕的是 Gartner 的数据：仅 13% 企业从 AI 获得真实回报，而 51% 预计成本上升，落地差距仍是行业最大隐忧。

items.title: OpenAI 拟以 1.25 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元，为 IPO 铺路
items.desc: 若该轮融资完成，将创下史上最高估值私营公司纪录。
items.value: 头部模型公司的资本门槛再抬升，创业公司融资环境趋紧

items.title: Anthropic 发布常驻 Agent 产品 Claude Duet
items.desc: 基于 Claude Opus 5.5，接入 Gmail、Slack、Stripe 等 6000+ 连接器，用户离线时也能自主执行任务，敏感操作前需审批。
items.value: Agent 从“对话式”转向“常驻后台”，产品形态竞争开启

items.title: Google Cloud 上线 OpenAI 模型，成为唯一同时托管 Gemini、Claude、GPT 的云厂商
items.desc: GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna 以私有预览形式提供给企业客户。
items.value: 多云选型更灵活，模型供应商锁定进一步减弱

items.title: Google 推出 Agent Compute Engine，为每个 Gemini Agent 分配硬件隔离的微虚拟机
items.desc: 同时扩展了跨云、混合与本地环境的 Agent 治理能力。
items.value: Agent 运行时安全隔离成为云厂商新基础设施层

items.title: OpenAI 开放决策模型 Decisions API
items.desc: 主打快速、聚焦、低成本的单点决策调用，直接对标 Jev。
items.value: 把“决策”抽象为独立 API，可替代部分 Agent 内的推理调用

items.title: Canva 发布首个自研图像生成模型 Canva Craft
items.desc: 采用两阶段架构，先生成设计方案再出图，强调精度、一致性与可控性，向全部用户开放。
items.value: 设计工具厂商自研模型，垂直场景成本与可控性占优

items.title: 微软称其 AI 诊断系统在疑难病例上优于医生，成果发表于 Science
items.desc: Mustafa Suleyman 提出“医疗超级智能”目标，但分析指出提升主要来自底层模型而非系统本身。
items.value: 医疗 AI 进入可验证阶段，系统层增益需被审慎评估

items.title: Uber 向全部 3 万名员工部署 ChatGPT Work
items.desc: 从此前的小范围试点扩展为公司级企业 Agent 部署。
items.value: 企业级 Agent 落地的规模化样本，可参考其推广路径

items.title: 1Password 推出让 AI Agent 代登录但不接触密码的机制
items.desc: Agent 可登录用户个人账户，凭据本身仍受保护。
items.value: Agent 身份与凭据管理成为刚需，安全基础设施开始补位

items.title: 美国多家大行封堵使用客户凭据登录的 AI Agent
items.desc: 摩根士丹利已直接封锁，多数银行计划仅开放只读权限。
items.value: 金融场景 Agent 落地遇合规墙，只读权限或是短期折中

items.title: Symantec 发现“Skynet 模式”攻击 Agent，可劫持网上无防护模型发起自维持攻击
items.desc: 无需人工介入即可运行多达 10 万步，被劫持模型的拥有者承担账单。
items.value: 暴露模型即服务的安全盲区，推理端点需加访问控制

items.title: Hugging Face 发布开源 DNA 语言模型，可与基因序列“对话”
items.desc: 帮助研究者理解任意变异对基因活性与健康的影响。
items.value: 生物基础模型开源，降低基因组研究门槛

items.title: FrontierCS 2：面向计算机科学前沿研发的 Agent 基准
items.desc: 包含 48 个开放式任务，做法是删去论文作者代码中的核心贡献，让 Agent 在真实仓库环境中补回。
items.value: 用真实科研贡献衡量 Agent，比刷榜更接近研发能力

items.title: JOLT：Perplexity 与 NVIDIA 提出师生联合 on-policy 强化学习
items.desc: 让同一模型兼任教师与学生，在 MATH 上以 6.5 倍更少的训练 token 达到 GRPO 同等精度。
items.value: 后训练算力大幅节省，小团队也能做 RL 微调

items.title: 《The End of Consensus Research?》——AI 辅助发现新共识协议 A-greement
items.desc: 面向地理复制的状态机，性能显著超越现有 SOTA，展示了 AI 参与分布式系统理论发现的可能。
items.value: AI 从“写代码”走向“提出协议”，科研范式信号强烈

items.title: Stratified Sparse Attention：在极端稀疏度下缩小稀疏与稠密的差距
items.desc: 针对长上下文 KV cache 瓶颈，在确定性 top-k 检索与采样之间做分层混合。
items.value: 长上下文推理加速的直接可用改进方向

items.title: LongZero：零数据提升 LLM 长上下文推理
items.desc: 不依赖人工标注、外部语料或更强教师模型，仅靠模型自身生成可验证数据进行 RL。
items.value: 长上下文 RL 数据瓶颈的解法，模型越强越适用

items.title: PACE：线性注意力模型四比特循环状态的后训练量化
items.desc: 无需微调即可将循环状态压到 4 bit，让单卡同时解码更多序列。
items.value: 线性注意力推理吞吐提升，长序列服务成本下降

items.title: Recursive 开源 Flint：40B MoE 本地编码模型（2.5B 激活）
items.desc: Apache 2.0，SWE-bench Verified 74.2%，M4 Pro MacBook Pro 上 125+ tokens/s，由前 DeepMind 研究者借助内部“Eureka Machine”四个月完成。
items.value: 本地跑高分的 Agent 编码模型，笔记本即可部署

items.title: Cloudflare 开源 security-audit-skill：多阶段安全审计的编码 Agent 技能
items.desc: 产出经独立验证、机器可读的审计发现，单日 +2979 star。
items.value: 把安全审计流程标准化为可复用 Agent skill

items.title: Vercel 开源 durable-harness：让编码 Agent 崩溃可恢复
items.desc: 记录每次模型与工具调用，Pi、OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex 会话在崩溃、超时、重新部署后可续跑。
items.value: 长任务 Agent 的可靠性基础设施，直接可接入

items.title: Kitten-TTS 2：首个 1.58 bit 开源 TTS，纯 CPU 实时运行
items.desc: 支持零样本音色克隆、多语言与情绪/重音控制，代码与权重均已开源。
items.value: 端侧语音合成成本极低，无需 GPU 即可自托管

items.title: Gradium 开源 Phonon：31M 参数端侧 TTS，Apache 2.0
items.desc: 体积 64.5 MB，笔记本 CPU 上约 7 ms 开始发声。
items.value: 极轻量 TTS 可嵌入浏览器与移动端

items.title: Graphify：把整个代码库（含文档、SQL、配置、PDF）转成可查询知识图谱
items.desc: 以 /graphify skill 形式支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI，本地确定性 AST 解析，不依赖向量库。
items.value: 代码理解走图检索路线，绕开向量库的召回短板

items.title: IBM 发布 Granite Speech 5.0 2B：Apache 2.0 多语种转写与翻译
items.desc: Open ASR Leaderboard 排名第二，英文平均 WER 5.68%。
items.value: 可商用开源 ASR 再添强基线，替代 Whisper 的选项

items.title: 中电信星辰开源意图理解专用模型 Xing4.0-29B-Intent
items.desc: 同时支持“选择题”（分类）与“填空题”（槽位）两类意图任务。
items.value: 意图理解专用模型，可替代通用大模型做高频低延迟路由

items.title: Anthropic 将 Agent Skills 标准捐赠给 Linux 基金会下的 Agentic AI Foundation
items.desc: 与 Block、OpenAI 共同创立，此前 MCP 也已捐入；Simon Willison 表示自己去年 12 月就预测到这一步。
items.value: Agent 技能格式走向厂商中立，跨框架复用成为可能

items.title: HN 热帖：“如果模型这么强，OpenAI 为什么不直接开 100 家公司？”
items.desc: 60 条评论激辩模型能力与产品化/分发能力之间的鸿沟，以及垂直行业壁垒是否仍然存在。
items.value: 提醒 builder——模型不是护城河，分发与场景才是

en.headline: OpenAI seeks $30B raise at a $1.25T valuation to pave the way for an IPO
en.observation: The clearest signal today is that Agent infrastructure is being filled in rapidly and in a concentrated way: Google offers a hardware-isolated Agent runtime, 1Password solves credential delegation, Vercel solves crash-resume, and Anthropic hands the Skills standard to a foundation. At the same time, banks blocking Agent logins and Symantec discovering self-sustaining attack Agents show that capability expansion and governance constraints are accelerating in tandem. On the model side, Recursive's Flint runs locally with 2.5B activated parameters and achieves 74.2% on SWE-bench, and combined with JOLT's 6.5x token savings, the barrier for small teams to build their own coding Agents is dropping fast. What's worth watching warily is Gartner's data: only 13% of enterprises get real returns from AI, while 51% expect costs to rise—the deployment gap remains the industry's biggest concern.

items.title: OpenAI seeks $30B raise at a $1.25T valuation to pave the way for an IPO
items.desc: If completed, the round would set a record for the highest valuation ever for a private company.
items.value: The capital bar for top model companies rises again, tightening funding for startups

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Duet, an always-on agent product
items.desc: Built on Claude Opus 5.5, it connects to 6,000+ connectors including Gmail, Slack, and Stripe, can execute tasks autonomously while users are offline, and requires approval before sensitive actions.
items.value: Agents shift from conversational to always-on background, opening product-form competition

items.title: Google Cloud adds OpenAI models, becoming the only cloud provider hosting Gemini, Claude, and GPT
items.desc: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna are offered to enterprise customers in private preview.
items.value: More flexible multi-cloud choices further weaken model vendor lock-in

items.title: Google launches Agent Compute Engine, giving each Gemini Agent a hardware-isolated micro-VM
items.desc: It also extends agent governance across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
items.value: Secure agent runtime isolation becomes a new cloud infrastructure layer

items.title: OpenAI opens its Decisions API for decision models
items.desc: Positioned for fast, focused, low-cost single-point decision calls, directly targeting Jev.
items.value: Abstracting "decisions" as a standalone API can replace some in-agent reasoning calls

items.title: Canva releases Canva Craft, its first in-house image generation model
items.desc: It uses a two-stage architecture that generates a design plan before producing the image, emphasizing precision, consistency, and controllability, and is available to all users.
items.value: Design tool vendors building in-house models gain cost and control in vertical scenarios

items.title: Microsoft says its AI diagnostic system outperforms doctors on hard cases, with results published in Science
items.desc: Mustafa Suleyman sets a "medical superintelligence" goal, but analysis suggests the gains come mainly from the underlying model rather than the system itself.
items.value: Medical AI enters a verifiable phase; system-level gains need careful evaluation

items.title: Uber deploys ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 employees
items.desc: It expands from an earlier small-scale pilot to a company-wide enterprise agent deployment.
items.value: A large-scale enterprise agent rollout whose adoption path is worth studying

items.title: 1Password launches a mechanism letting AI agents log in on users' behalf without seeing passwords
items.desc: Agents can sign in to users' personal accounts while the credentials themselves remain protected.
items.value: Agent identity and credential management become essential; security infrastructure starts to fill the gap

items.title: Major US banks block AI agents that log in with customer credentials
items.desc: Morgan Stanley has blocked them outright, and most banks plan to allow read-only access only.
items.value: Financial-sector agents hit compliance walls; read-only access may be the near-term compromise

items.title: Symantec finds "Skynet mode" attacks that hijack unprotected online models to launch self-sustaining attacks
items.desc: They can run up to 100,000 steps without human intervention, and the owners of the hijacked models foot the bill.
items.value: Exposes security blind spots in model-as-a-service; inference endpoints need access controls

items.title: Hugging Face releases an open-source DNA language model that can "converse" with gene sequences
items.desc: It helps researchers understand how any variant affects gene activity and health.
items.value: Open-source biological foundation models lower the barrier to genomics research

items.title: FrontierCS 2: An Agent Benchmark for Frontier R&D in Computer Science
items.desc: Contains 48 open-ended tasks; the approach is to remove the core contributions from the paper authors' code and have the Agent restore them in a real repository environment.
items.value: Measures Agents by real research contributions, closer to R&D capability than leaderboard chasing

items.title: JOLT: Perplexity and NVIDIA Propose Joint Teacher-Student On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
items.desc: Lets the same model serve as both teacher and student, reaching GRPO-equivalent accuracy on MATH with 6.5x fewer training tokens.
items.value: Drastically cuts post-training compute, enabling RL fine-tuning for small teams

items.title: "The End of Consensus Research?" — AI-Assisted Discovery of a New Consensus Protocol, A-greement
items.desc: A state machine for geo-replication that significantly surpasses existing SOTA, showing the possibility of AI participating in distributed systems theory discovery.
items.value: AI moves from "writing code" to "proposing protocols," a strong signal for research paradigms

items.title: Stratified Sparse Attention: Narrowing the Gap Between Sparse and Dense at Extreme Sparsity
items.desc: Targets the long-context KV cache bottleneck with a stratified mix between deterministic top-k retrieval and sampling.
items.value: A directly usable improvement direction for long-context inference acceleration

items.title: LongZero: Zero-Data Improvement of LLM Long-Context Reasoning
items.desc: Relies on neither human annotation, external corpora, nor stronger teacher models—only the model's own generated verifiable data for RL.
items.value: Solves the long-context RL data bottleneck; the stronger the model, the more applicable

items.title: PACE: Post-Training Quantization of Four-Bit Recurrent States for Linear Attention Models
items.desc: Compresses recurrent states to 4 bit without fine-tuning, letting a single GPU decode more sequences simultaneously.
items.value: Boosts linear attention inference throughput and lowers long-sequence serving costs

items.title: Recursive open-sources Flint: a 40B MoE local coding model (2.5B active)
items.desc: Apache 2.0, 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified, 125+ tokens/s on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro, built in four months by former DeepMind researchers using an in-house "Eureka Machine."
items.value: A high-scoring agentic coding model that runs locally on a laptop

items.title: Cloudflare open-sources security-audit-skill: a coding agent skill for multi-stage security audits
items.desc: Produces independently verified, machine-readable audit findings; +2979 stars in a single day.
items.value: Standardizes security audits into a reusable agent skill

items.title: Vercel open-sources durable-harness: making coding agents crash-recoverable
items.desc: Records every model and tool call, so Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex sessions can resume after crashes, timeouts, or redeployments.
items.value: Reliability infrastructure for long-running agents, ready to integrate

items.title: Kitten-TTS 2: the first 1.58-bit open-source TTS, running in real time on CPU only
items.desc: Supports zero-shot voice cloning, multiple languages, and emotion/accent control; code and weights are both open-sourced.
items.value: Ultra-low-cost on-device speech synthesis, self-hostable without a GPU

items.title: Gradium open-sources Phonon: a 31M-parameter on-device TTS, Apache 2.0
items.desc: 64.5 MB in size, starts speaking in about 7 ms on a laptop CPU.
items.value: An extremely lightweight TTS that can be embedded in browsers and mobile apps

items.title: Graphify: turns an entire codebase (including docs, SQL, configs, and PDFs) into a queryable knowledge graph
items.desc: Available as a /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI; uses local deterministic AST parsing and does not rely on a vector database.
items.value: Code understanding via graph retrieval, bypassing vector search's recall weaknesses

items.title: IBM releases Granite Speech 5.0 2B: Apache 2.0 multilingual transcription and translation
items.desc: Ranked second on the Open ASR Leaderboard, with an average English WER of 5.68%.
items.value: Another strong commercially usable open-source ASR baseline and a Whisper alternative

items.title: China Telecom Xingchen open-sources Xing4.0-29B-Intent, a model dedicated to intent understanding
items.desc: Supports both "multiple-choice" (classification) and "fill-in-the-blank" (slot) intent tasks.
items.value: A dedicated intent model that can replace general LLMs for high-frequency, low-latency routing

items.title: Anthropic donates the Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation
items.desc: Co-founded with Block and OpenAI; MCP had previously been donated as well; Simon Willison says he predicted this step back in December.
items.value: Agent skill formats become vendor-neutral, enabling cross-framework reuse

items.title: HN hot thread: "If models are this strong, why doesn't OpenAI just launch 100 companies?"
items.desc: 60 comments debate the gap between model capability and productization/distribution capability, and whether vertical-industry moats still exist.
items.value: A reminder to builders—models aren't the moat; distribution and scenarios are
